_comment: Temas de cosméticos (pedido do matheus em 19/10/2026): variar bastante, como no DDTank (surfista, piloto de avião, hip hop, espadachim, pirata, bobo da corte, chapéu fedora com óculos escuros, moletom com coroa...). Cada conjunto vira prompts do Codex com `node scripts/cosmetic-prompts.mjs --set=<id>` (--run gera). A arte segue SEMPRE o estilo das peças aprovadas anexadas; um tema muda roupa e acessórios, nunca o estilo de pintura, salvo pedido explícito.

ideas.outfit: camisa havaiana aberta sobre regata, bermuda de surfe estampada, chinelos
jaqueta de couro de aviador com gola de pelúcia, cachecol branco, calça cargo, botas
ideas.hat: touca de couro de aviador (capacete justo)

ideas.outfit: moletom largo, corrente dourada, calça jogger, tênis grandes
haori sobre quimono, hakama, faixa na cintura, sandálias com meia
casaca rasgada, colete, faixa vermelha, botas dobradas
ideas.glasses: tapa-olho (não cabe no slot de óculos: usar óculos redondos de pirata)

ideas.outfit: gibão de losangos em duas cores, gola de babados com guizos
ideas.hat: chapéu de bobo de três pontas com guizos

ideas.outfit: terno risca de giz, colete, gravata
moletom com capuz, calça de moletom, tênis

sets.theme: hip hop de rua, estiloso e confiante

outfit.name: Rima de Rua
outfit.brief: an oversized street-style hip hop outfit: a big hoodie in saturated purple with a bold gold graffiti star print on the chest, the hood down behind the neck, a chunky gold chain with a round medallion, baggy black cargo joggers with side pockets, chunky white-and-purple high-top sneakers with fat laces, bare hands (skin #FCD0AC), one hand in the hoodie pocket, the other relaxed, cool laid-back stance
outfit.walkParts: big purple hoodie, gold chain with medallion, black cargo joggers, chunky high-top sneakers

hair.name: Degradê Trançado
hair.brief: a male hip hop haircut: a short skin fade on the sides and nape that still comes down to the ear with a clear dark faded sideburn in front of the ear, and on top short twisted locs (small thick twists) pointing up and slightly back, black with dark violet highlights

hat.name: Boné Aba Reta
hat.brief: a hip hop snapback cap with a perfectly FLAT straight brim pointing forward-right, purple crown, black flat brim with a gold edge and a gold metallic star badge on the front, a small round sticker on the brim

glasses.name: Óculos Escuros Neon
glasses.brief: bold rectangular street sunglasses with a thick glossy black frame and gold corner studs, dark smoky violet lenses (semi-transparent so the eyes still show) with a neon pink-to-cyan reflection streak

outfit.name: Espadachim Errante
outfit.brief: a wandering swordsman outfit (samurai-inspired, original design): a teal haori jacket with white wave patterns at the hem worn over a white kimono, a dark indigo hakama (wide pleated trousers), a red sash tied at the waist with the knot on the side, white tabi socks with straw sandals, bare hands (skin #FCD0AC), one hand resting on the sash, the other relaxed. NO sword, no sheath, nothing in the hands
outfit.walkParts: teal haori with white wave hem, white kimono, red sash, indigo hakama, straw sandals

hair.name: Coque do Errante
hair.brief: a male swordsman hairstyle: hair swept back from the forehead into a SMALL compact topknot tied with a red cord on the back of the crown (the knot stays low, barely above the skull), the side hair coming down to the ear with a neat sideburn in front of the ear down to the middle of the ear, no locks on the forehead, the face completely free, deep navy black with blue highlights

hat.name: Chapéu de Palha Errante
hat.brief: a conical woven straw traveller's hat (kasa), worn on the head like a wide sun hat: a shallow cone with a small knob on top, visible woven texture, a red cord band around it and a small teal tassel hanging from the side, the brim an even wide ellipse around the head at brow height, seen from slightly above so only the top of the hat shows

hair.name: Corte Capitão
hair.brief: short, neat swept-back male cut with a confident side-swept quiff, a few sharp locks falling to the forehead on the right side (still above the eyebrows), short sides and nape, dark chestnut brown with warm copper highlights
